jlptLevels.desc: Ability to understand basic Japanese in everyday situations.

jlptLevels.name: Intermediate
jlptLevels.desc: Ability to understand Japanese in everyday situations to a certain degree.

jlptLevels.name: Advanced

jlptLevels.name: Proficient

japaneseLevels.title: Conversational Japanese Language
japaneseLevels.desc: The course is for those who have not studied Japanese Language. Basic sentences, patterns, conversational expressions and kanji are introduced through pattern practices and interactive programs. Students are entitled to appear in N5 of the Japanese Language Proficiency Test.

japaneseLevels.title: Fast Track Basic Japanese Language
japaneseLevels.desc: This course is for you if you have no prior knowledge of Japanese Language. You will learn basic skills to enable you to make yourself understood and to find out information in everyday situations. An accelerated approach to core fundamentals.

japaneseLevels.title: Basic Japanese Language Course
japaneseLevels.desc: For those who have not studied Japanese language. Basic sentences, patterns, conversational expressions and kanji are introduced through pattern practices and interactive programs. Students are entitled to appear in N5 of the Japanese Language Proficiency Test.

japaneseLevels.title: Intermediate Japanese Language Course
japaneseLevels.desc: This course is for students who have completed the basic course. It offers 400 kanji, 2000 words and lessons for writing and reading in simple sentences. It enables students to appear in N4 of the Japanese Language Proficiency Test.

japaneseLevels.title: Upper Intermediate Japanese Language
japaneseLevels.desc: Students who have completed Intermediate I are entitled to join this course, where they are trained in intermediate-level sentence patterns and conversational expressions. The course enables students to read, write, and speak in Japanese, making them eligible for N3 of JLPT.

japaneseLevels.title: Advanced Japanese Language Course
japaneseLevels.desc: This course introduces advanced level sentence patterns and conversation. After completion, students will be able to have smooth conversation with Japanese speakers on different topics and write or translate business-related documents. It enables interpretation proficiency and makes students eligible for N2 of JLPT.
